elements.name: Sell This Product As An Exam
elements.subtitle: Switch this on and the product becomes an exam: buying it grants a candidate access, and you build its papers and cases from the Papers and Cases screens. Everything commercial stays where it already is — the price, tax, discounts and catalogue listing on the tabs beside this one.

elements.label: This product is an exam
elements.hint: Switching it off removes the exam from the catalogue and stops new enrolments. Nothing is deleted: the papers, the cases and every sitting anybody has taken are all kept, and switching it back on restores them

elements.label: Access Window (days)
elements.hint: How long access lasts from the moment a candidate starts. Copied onto each enrolment when it is created, so changing it here affects future sittings only and can never shorten a window somebody already holds

elements.label: Target Score (%)
elements.hint: The percentage of the maximum a candidate is aiming at, shown before they have a score of their own

elements.label: Stated Duration (minutes)
elements.hint: Display only, shown on the exam card. Each paper carries the timer that actually counts down

elements.name: Before It Sells
elements.subtitle: Two things are worth checking on the tabs beside this one. Turn Requires Shipping OFF — an exam has nothing to post, and with it off checkout never asks the candidate for an address or charges a delivery fee. And set the product Active, or it will not appear in the catalogue however this tab is configured.
